1.35.betting_forecast: 5/2 Signora, 100/30 Ridersinthesky, 9/2 Rayzera, 11/2 Expert Dancer, 12/1 Green Interlude, 14/1 White Lily, 20/1 Billy Jean, 22/1
1.35.spotlight_verdict: Although proving expensive to follow after failing to justify favouritism on her last three starts, SIGNORA may finally be able to make the breakthrough. Placed in a Group 3 on debut, she has finished runner-up in two runs this season and if the ground dries it could help her further. Ridersinthesky has the form to be a big danger but lacks a recent run. Rayzera and Expert Dancer have place claims. [Denis Harney]

3.15.betting_forecast: 9/2 Lady Arwen, 7/1 Bella Colombia, 15/2 Burford Beauty, Electric Night, 9/1 Glamazon, 10/1 Deuteronomy, Medieval Night, 11/1
3.15.spotlight_verdict: A tricky race to get a handle on, but it's interesting that blinkers go back on DEUTERONOMY. The C&D winner excelled when headgear was applied last year, winning three on the bounce, and they had been discarded in his poor opening runs this season. Electric Night could go well on her turf debut after posting some decent AW efforts. Bella Colombia was a winner at Dundalk last time and is another with claims. The form of Lady Arwen's Gowran win doesn't look the strongest. [Denis Harney]

horses.spotlight_comment: Cases can be made for a few of these. The recent Gowran winner Rion Rubette should go well again if this doesn't come too soon. Lady Lilac is another big player but COLLECTING COIN is narrowly preferred after his pleasing comeback run at Naas with the step back up to 1m a plus. Market support for Um Wadi and \Motu Proprio should be noted and drying ground could elicit an improved effort from Dark Summit. [Dave Stephens] Page 11 spotlightlimerick 25.04.26
